test_title: PYST 73: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct Active Voice form of the given sentence:

The roof had been painted by the workers before the rain started.

options.text: The workers painted the roof before the rain started.
The workers had painted the roof before the rain started.
The roof paints the workers before the rain started.
The workers were painting the roof before the rain started.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Identify the Tense:** The sentence "The roof had been painted by the workers before the rain started" is in the **Past Perfect Tense** (Passive Voice).
 
• **Passive to Active Conversion:** For the Past Perfect tense, the passive structure *"had been + $V_3$"* changes to the active structure **"had + $V_3$"**.
 
• **Subject and Object:** The agent in the passive sentence ("the workers") becomes the subject in the active sentence, and "the roof" becomes the object.
 
• **Time Clause:** The phrase "before the rain started" describes the timing of the action and remains unchanged at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The workers had painted the roof before the rain started."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The workers painted..." – Incorrect because it uses the **Simple Past Tense**.
 
• **Option 3: **"The roof paints..." – Incorrect because it is logically nonsensical (the roof cannot perform the action of painting) and uses the **Simple Present Tense**.
 
• **Option 4: **"The workers were painting..." – Incorrect because it uses the **Past Continuous Tense**.
